title: Chapter 317: Continue To Expand The Army And Plan To Occupy The City
content:
Chapter 317: Continue To Expand The Army And Plan To Occupy The City

In terms of the combat power of conventional armies, the demons and bear goblins were no match for the Zerg. After repeated considerations, the two tribes still did not send out eight-star strongmen.

Eight-star strongmen have a high status in the big tribes and cannot be easily lost.

The demons and bear goblins joined forces to force all the races in this area to send troops. They fought with the Zerg army for a day and a night, but finally gave up helplessly.

They personally experienced what the representatives of the aliens said before leaving. When they thought that if they tried harder, the Zerg army would not be able to hold on for a long time, the Zerg army would always give them a surprise.

The demons and bear goblins took the initiative to abandon the coalition positions, dismantled all space transmission channels, and all important forces were withdrawn to the tribe.

The remaining evil god camp troops have become abandoned. This behavior is more euphemistic in the evil god camp. Everyone stayed to sacrifice for the gods and upper demons they believed in, which is a supreme honor.

Therefore, the morale of the remaining evil god camp troops was not affected at all, and they are still fighting with all their strength.

Of course, the Zerg army would not be polite. After the Zerg host found that the main force of the evil god camp had retreated, it began to advance step by step, striving to end this war as soon as possible.

The sky was bright again, and the battlefields in the giant city of the evil god camp and the surrounding areas were all under the control of the Zerg army.

I don’t know how many soldiers of the evil god camp fell on this battlefield. The battlefield without corpses and blood smell was not too tragic except that it looked a little dilapidated and desolate.

The Zerg puppy cooperated with the Zerg host to explore the entire battlefield and eliminate all hidden dangers.

A team of transport-type Zerg hosts flew over and put down a large number of Zerg worker bees. Under this extremely advantageously located giant city of the evil god camp, according to the construction standards of the Zerg sub-base, the fourth Zerg sub-base was built.

With the current strength of the Zerg, there is the existence of the space transmission building of the pupa channel, plus the constant protection of the queen, as long as it is necessary, the Zerg sub-base can be built at will, and there is no need to consider safety issues.

In the future, Zerg sub-bases will appear more and more in various parts of this world.

The completion of this fourth Zerg sub-base will become a nail inserted into the sphere of influence of the evil god camp, supporting the Zerg army to launch an attack on the territories of various races in the evil god camp, led by the two major tribes of the demon tribe and the bear goblin tribe.

It would be better if the evil god camp could be attracted to attack actively. It doesn't matter if the evil god camp dares not to attack. The Zerg army will take the initiative to attack and strive to eliminate the status of the demon tribe and the bear goblin tribe as soon as possible.

The status of the races in the evil god camp is similar to the status of the races in the native race camp, but the nature is different.

The status of the races in the native race camp is given by the world rules of this world, while the status of the races in the evil god camp is snatched from this world by those evil gods.

The camp war, in other words, can also be said to be a fight between the two sides for the authority of the rules of this world.

The more races in the evil god camp the Zerg defeats, the greater the benefits will be.

With the experience of building the first three Zerg sub-bases, the fourth Zerg sub-base was quickly built. A large number of Zerg worker bees came to the battlefield on the ground and moved all kinds of spoils into the Zerg sub-base.

Valuable spoils can be transferred to other sub-bases through the pupa channel and handed over to the Great Xia Territory, the Alliance or the Goblin Chamber of Commerce for processing.

Those spoils of little value were all converted into system resources after the Zerg mother nest.

A large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions were hatched and rushed to the sphere of influence of the evil god camp, joining the Zerg offensive forces.

After resting, the 21 Zerg air forces dispersed again and continued to attack the territories of the races of the evil god camp with certain strength.

In this battle, the Zerg army repelled a super tribe and two tribes of the evil god camp, plus an unknown number of other races of the evil god camp, and the harvest was very huge.

The rewards of the world rules arrived as expected. In addition to a large amount of luck rewards, the progress of the Zerg in obtaining the status of a tribe has been pushed to more than 90%. It won’t be long before the Zerg will obtain this extremely difficult status of a tribe.

In the recent battles that the Zerg has fought, it is difficult for the big tribes in this world to win any enemy. Only those super big tribes with extremely deep foundations can fight.

Especially the battle with the weird is even more difficult.

After so many battles, the Zerg has pushed the progress of the Zerg to the status of a big tribe to this extent. Generally, races that are not even as good as big tribes have no hope of taking this path.

Even if there are races with the strength of super big tribes, they still have little hope of taking this path to obtain the status of a big tribe.

In this world, the Zerg is an exception.

…

The Zerg's anti-weird troops fought another anti-weird battle last night and killed another eight-star weird. The Zerg has killed nine eight-star weirds in total. They only need to kill one eight-star enemy before the Zerg mother nest can be upgraded to eight stars.

Tonight, they will fight another big battle with the weird. The Zerg will obtain the status of a big tribe and the Zerg mother nest will be upgraded to eight stars.

It was still early, and Wu Qing couldn't wait any longer.

In the main city of the alien race in the 108th zone of the Southern Theater's public battlefield, Wu Qing had given the alien race a long time to prepare.

As long as the Zerg army captures this main city of the alien race, the main cities of the alien race in other areas will be broken one by one. This is an immeasurable blow to the alien race, a super tribe of the evil god camp.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

Therefore, the alien race will never give up the main city attacked by the Zerg army easily.

Through the six-star Zerg host, the Zerg has discovered that there are many races that have never been seen in the city. Combined with the information provided by the goblin race, some of these races are the big tribes in the evil god camp.

Combined with the situation of the local races, it can be inferred that a super tribe will always gather around a group of big tribes, and everyone will keep warm together.

These evil god camp big tribes that came to the main city of the alien race should be the races gathered around the alien race, a super tribe of the evil god camp.

After yesterday's battle in the sphere of influence of the demon tribe and the bear goblin tribe, the alien race further tested the combat effectiveness of the Zerg army and found that many of the means they had originally prepared were simply ineffective against the Zerg army.

Wu Qing was ready to take action so quickly because he didn't give the aliens too much time to react, forcing them to use many methods that would cost a lot.

The more the aliens paid, the more they lost, and the greater the Zerg's gains.

The main city of the aliens was a super city that was many times larger than the entire battlefield of yesterday's battle. After so many days of preparation, the aliens moved out the ordinary believers who affected their combat effectiveness in batches. Those who stayed were either the army or the logistics personnel who provided services to the army.

The main force of the Zerg army that had been attacking was the only ground main combat force of the Zerg and the air main combat force with a force equivalent to two Zerg air force detachments. The total force of the Zerg main combat force was less than five million.

This Zerg army, because of the change in Wu Qing's strategic focus, has changed from the strongest Zerg to the weakest now.

The Zerg army's offensive intensity is not great. After so many days of fighting, it has only captured a small urban area and is counterattacked by the alien army from time to time.

However, after so many days of accumulation, the number of Zerg puppies and Type III Zerg poisonous ray scorpions has reached an astonishing number. They have almost completely cleared the huge lord protection range of the entire Tianwai human main city.

Wu Qing is preparing to launch a full-scale attack on the Tianwai human main city. The first step is to strengthen the strength of the Zerg offensive force.

The team composed of 500 six-star Zerg queens and 500 six-star Zerg scorpions that has not taken action since the second half of the night yesterday has obtained enough rest time and was transmitted to the first Zerg sub-base on the public battlefield through the pupa channel of the fourth Zerg sub-base.

In the underground Zerg first sub-base in the 66th city of the 108th area of the public battlefield in the southern theater, 20 Zerg air forces that have just hatched according to the standard configuration of the Zerg air force detachment are ready.

The Zerg main combat force of more than 10 million, including a large number of high-star arms, once again almost consumed the large amount of resources accumulated by the system in the past few days.

But these Zerg main combat troops are indispensable. The Zerg will soon gain the status of a large tribe. It is very necessary for the Zerg to form three powerful armies in the public battlefield, the sphere of influence of the evil god camp and the desert territory.

In the future, according to the changes in the situation, it is foreseeable that several more strong armies will be built in the underground world or other directions.

Tens of millions of Zerg flying troops continue to appear and fly towards the main city of the alien human race. The black Zerg flying troops are like a huge black cloth pulled up in the sky, covering the entire sky.

This strange phenomenon made the personnel of various forces in the local camp who have been gathering nearby in recent days exclaim.

"The Zerg has dispatched so many air forces! This is going to be a big battle!"

"Look! Those huge Zerg flying troops, according to the news from the front, they are the most powerful ultimate troops of the Zerg, with extremely strong combat power. Now so many troops have been dispatched at once, it seems that they are going to launch a full-scale attack on the main city of the alien race!"

"The Zerg must have completed the assembly of troops and are about to launch a full-scale attack! This historic moment, we must not miss it!"

"Quick! We move forward lightly! Follow the reinforcements of the Zerg ground troops, it is very safe!"

"Attack the main city of the evil god camp! What an honor! We must participate!"

"As long as we take down the main city of the alien race, this public war zone will be ours!"

"We will definitely not be able to intervene in the battle to attack the main city! After the main city is taken, we must show our skills when we come back to clean up other cities!"

"Brothers who are fast, follow me! We will follow the Zerg's flying troops!"

"The flying troops go in a straight line, be careful that the road will be blocked!"

"..."

The large-scale appearance of the Zerg air force made everyone see Wu Qing's plan.
